title: Holy Mother's Birthday Celebration | Belur Math | 26 December 2021
description:
Holy Mother Sri Sarada Devi’s birthday will be celebrated on 26 December 2021 at Belur Math. The celebrations will be live-streamed on Youtube and Facebook.

NOTICE
-------------

It is notified for all concerned that:

On Sunday, 26 December 2021, the Birthday of Holy Mother Sri Sarada Devi, the Belur Math gates will be open for visitors and devotees during the following hours: Morning: 8.00 to 11.00; Afternoon: 3.30 to 5.00.

On that day the devotees may visit Sri Ramakrishna Temple, Holy Mother Sri Sarada Devi Temple, Swami Vivekananda Temple and Swami Brahmananda Temple.

Devotees may also offer pranams to Revered President Maharaj and Revered Vice-President Maharajs at the allotted time.
